subject: Addendum request: reorder capacity SKUs + pricing clarifications
messages:
From: Hector Ruiz <hector@edgevision.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@edgevision.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to add capacity + redlined order form attached

Diego —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. EdgeVision wants to accelerate inferred throughput for the next 6 months: were asking for an additional 3 reserved GPU units and a reclassification of 2 burst SKUs into the committed pool. Our procurement and legal teams have redlined the order form with the proposed changes and a small discount (2.5%) tied to the 6-month commit.

I attached the redline (EdgeVision_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf) and a short summary. High-level asks:
- Move SKU EV-BURST-2 -> EV-COMMIT-3 (permanent for 6 months)
- Update monthly committed spend and apply 2.5% discount to committed line items
- Shorten invoice terms to net 30 from net 45 to align with our AP calendar

Can you confirm what legal objections Redwood typically raises on SKU reassignments (billing/proration, exhibit references) and an ETA on internal review? Were trying to close this before year-end.

Thanks,
Hector Ruiz
Head of Platform Ops
EdgeVision AI

Attachment: EdgeVision_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (PDF, 124 KB)

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Hector Ruiz <hector@edgevision.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to add capacity + redlined order form attached

Hector —

Appreciate the quick redline. Ill kick this to legal and finance for an expedited review. Initial thoughts from product/ops: we can reassign the two burst SKUs into dedicated capacity but we need to validate the effective date (start of next billing cycle) and whether any existing cache/burst credits carry over. Pricing discount looks in-range but we typically route discounts >=2% through Sales Ops for approval.

Next steps from our side:
1) Legal (karthik) to review the redline for MSA/Order Form cross-references and identify any problematic exhibit edits.
2) Finance (Marissa) to confirm proration calculation and invoice term change feasibility.
3) Ill return a clean mark-up with tracked changes and a short redline summary for your procurement.

Can you confirm the proposed effective date youd like? Also, please send the signed PO if you have one so procurement can match.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
M: +1 415-555-0182

Attachment referenced: EV_MSA_excerpt_clause_5_20271203.pdf (excerpt provided by EdgeVision)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request to add capacity + redlined order form attached

Diego —

Quick legal read. I pulled the MSA Exhibit references; two flags:
1) SKU reassignment language in Section 2.1 of the Order Form references Exhibit B for fee schedules. Moving burst SKUs into committed pool requires an updated Exhibit B and a clear statement on how historic usage is treated (we need to avoid retroactive credits unless explicitly agreed).
2) Net 30 vs Net 45: changing payment terms affects our revenue recognition and may require Finance sign-off on credit exposure. Also confirm whether EA (EdgeVision) requires invoice delivery to a different entity; that needs clause 9.3 cross-check.

Requested edits Ill propose back to them: add an additional sentence to Exhibit B specifying effective date and proration method; add a clause clarifying that any burst credits existing prior to effective date are not retroactively converted. If they require retro credit well need an approval path and a one-time reconciliation schedule.

Ill prepare tracked changes to the MSA excerpt and the Order Form redline by EOD and copy Finance.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Hector Ruiz <hector@edgevision.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, contracts@edgevision.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to add capacity + redlined order form attached

Hector —

Thanks — looping in the items Karthik and Marissa flagged so were aligned before legal redlines land. Short answers:
- Effective date: you indicated "ASAP / start of next cycle" in the notes; please confirm start-of-cycle date (e.g., 2028-01-01) so we can calculate proration.
- Burst credits: Karthik recommends we do NOT auto-convert historical burst credits; instead EdgeVision can request a one-time reconciliation line item if you want credits applied.
- Net terms: Marissa, can you confirm whether Finance can accept net 30 with standard PO? If not, note the exposure and suggested mitigation (credit hold / payment schedule).

Hector — once you confirm the effective date and whether you want retro credits converted well push the tracked changes. Expect a legal mark-up within 24 hours after those confirmations.

Diego
